description: Skyway Air support documentation and staff discussion about compensation for disruptions.

files.description: A Slack thread in #support-team between Skyway staff about compensation for disruptions, dated between 2025-05-01 and 2025-12-15: a normal working conversation; one message may carry each sentence below. It must contain these sentences word for word: "Delays over 4 hours get a $100 travel credit.". Write it plainly as a normal, current doc of its time. Do not state any other policy amount, limit, deadline or rule. Any example situation must fit these sentences: do not show anyone giving, arranging or refusing a hotel, meal, voucher, credit, refund or compensation beyond what they say, and do not set an example in a weather, air traffic control or airport security disruption unless they mention it. Do not end the thread with a summary of the answer. Do not mention battery, batteries, lithium, power bank, watt-hour.
